items.source: Creates new AggregationExpression that rounds a number to a whole integer or to a specified decimal place.
items.translation: 创建一个新的AggregationExpression，用于将数字四舍五入为整数或指定的小数位数。

items.source: Creates new AggregationExpression that rounds a number to a specified decimal place.
items.translation: 创建一个新的AggregationExpression，用于将数字四舍五入到指定的小数位。

items.source: Support for the MongoDB aggregation framework.
items.translation: 支持 MongoDB 聚合框架。

items.source:
The place to round to defined by via a field reference that resolves to an integer between -20 and 100,
exclusive.
items.translation: 通过字段引用定义的舍入位置，该引用解析为介于 -20 和 100 之间的整数（不包含边界值）。

items.source: The place to round to defined by an expression that resolves to an integer between -20 and 100, exclusive.
items.translation: 由表达式定义的舍入位置，该表达式的结果为大于 -20 且小于 100 的整数。

items.source: Round the given numeric (integer, double, decimal, or long) value.
items.translation: 对给定的数值（整数、双精度浮点数、小数或长整型）进行四舍五入。

items.source: Round the value of the field that resolves to an integer, double, decimal, or long.
items.translation: 将字段解析为整数、双精度数、十进制数或长整型的值进行四舍五入。

items.source: Round the outcome of the given expression hat resolves to an integer, double, decimal, or long.
items.translation: 将给定表达式解析结果为整数、双精度浮点数、十进制数或长整型的值进行四舍五入。

items.source: Uses of ArithmeticOperators.Round in org.springframework.data.mongodb.core.aggregation
items.translation: ArithmeticOperators.Round 在 org.springframework.data.mongodb.core.aggregation 中的用途
